title: Check Digit Calculation - Modulo-10 Algorithm
text: The check digit for GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, and GTIN-14 is calculated using the standard Modulo-10 algorithm. Starting from the right of the payload (excluding check position), digits are multiplied alternately by 3 and 1. The sum of these products is calculated, and the check digit is the smallest non-negative integer that, when added to this sum, yields a multiple of 10. If the sum is already a multiple of 10, the check digit is 0.

title: Application Identifier AI (01), AI (17), AI (10), AI (21)
text: Application Identifier (01) denotes a fixed-length 14-digit Global Trade Item Number. AI (17) denotes a fixed-length 6-digit expiration date in YYMMDD format, where day 00 indicates the last day of the stated month. AI (10) denotes a variable-length alphanumeric batch or lot number up to 20 characters, terminated by FNC1 when unbracketed. AI (21) denotes serial number.
